logic.top_level: pathways keyed by indication, and within each pathway the criterion is membership of a named product list; plus a very long 'all other products are investigational' denylist

k_of_n.quote: meets the definition of medical necessity for ONE of the following indications:

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: Collagen dressing: 'does not meet the definition of medical necessity for wounds with heavy exudate, third-degree burns, or when an active vasculitis is present.' Elsewhere 'All other uses ... do not meet' and 'All other indications not listed above are considered experimental or investigational'.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: No criteria for repeat use in the Position Statement; Reimbursement caps applications: 'Apligraf® is limited to five (5) applications per ulcer' and 're-treatment of a single wound using Apligraf®, Dermagraft® or OrCel™ ... is considered experimental or Investigational.'

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Treatment of chronic, noninfected, partial- or full-thickness lower extremity skin ulcers due to venous insufficiency, which have not adequately responded following a one-month period of conventional ulcer therapy, using the following ...
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'partial- or full-thickness' vs the DFU line 'full-thickness' only; 'adequately responded' and 'conventional ulcer therapy' undefined.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Collagen-based dressing or wound filler meets the definition of medical necessity for full thickness wounds (e.g., stage 3 or 4 ulcers), wounds with light to moderate exudate, or wounds that have stalled or have not progressed toward a healing goal.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Three coverage conditions joined by 'or', then exclusions in the next sentence; 'e.g.' makes stage 3/4 an example, not a rule.

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Partly. HCPCS Q-codes are one per product and each is tagged '(Investigational)' where the product is not covered, so the code list is itself a deny list. ICD-10 table (breast cancer C50.*, D05, E08-E13 foot ulcers, I83 varicose with ulcer, etc.) is a flat support list not mapped to the per-indication paragraphs. 'Application codes (15271-15278, G0681-G0684) must be submitted with product codes' and are denied with investigational products.
codes.non_covered_code_lists: 15011-15018, 1044T-1049T, and many Q4xxx/A2xxx product codes labelled '(Investigational)'; the ICD ranges are sloppy (e.g. 'C50.411 – C50.519' spans categories).

extraction_hazards: Position Statement is ~340 lines, ~257 of them are product names in a bullet list; 286 '•' characters in three layouts ('•  name' on one line, a lone '•' with the name on the next line, or a name with no bullet), and the list breaks across pages with indentation changes.
Footnote asterisks (*, **, ***, ****) after product names carry FDA status and are footnoted below the list; a parser that strips asterisks loses 'Banked Human Tissue' and HDE conditions.
Brand names with ®/™ symbols, line-wrapped names ('Amnio-maxx or Manio-maxx lite'), and typos ('Aongen', 'Amniorepair or AltiPly') make exact matching fragile.
Coding section is ~700 lines: 'Qxxxx name, per square centimeter (add-on, list separately ...)' with '(Investigational)' on the next, indented line; the tag detaches from its code on line wraps.
Page-break ('\f') falls in the middle of the product list; no repeated header text but indentation shifts after the break.
Two criteria are only reachable through the Reimbursement section (application caps) while the Position Statement says nothing of limits.
interesting_structures: Coverage is a lookup: indication x product list; whether a product is covered is data, not logic.
Denylist of ~257 named products and an explicit 'all other' catch-all, mirrored in billing codes tagged (Investigational).
Per-product quantity limits in the Reimbursement section (applications per ulcer, per site per 12 weeks).
Four different FDA-status footnote markers drive meaning on covered products.
Document title carries two topics ('Skin and Soft Tissue Substitutes; Amniotic Membrane and Amniotic Fluid') plus collagen dressings and skin cell suspension autografts.

fit_to_tree.why: each indication is a small any-of/all-of, but the heart of the document is product-list membership, a 257-name denylist and per-product caps in another section; it needs a product lookup table beside the tree rather than more tree.
